name: Meridian Industrial Equipment
figuresNote: Fictional company. Profile figures are illustrative.
descriptor: Mid-market OEM that sells and services commercial industrial equipment, with a large installed base under service contracts.
today: Requests arrive by phone, email, and an external portal and are re-keyed. Dispatch runs on spreadsheets and trust, and technicians record work in a separate shop system.
ambition: Service leadership wants one intake, scheduling, and dispatch backbone first, then to run service as a margin line.
painPoints: Requests arrive through several channels and are re-keyed before anyone can schedule them.
Dispatch cannot see who owns a job or whether it is waiting, stalled, or done.
Technicians arrive without the machine's history or warranty status.
Parts, pricing, and completion details are captured inconsistently, so billing lags.

record.notice: Every session starts with the fictional client. Customer records stay in this browser until you export them; nothing is sent to the site.
